column.value: Multi-tranche pipeline report: loan and client identity, office, loan officer, product, approved principal, tranche count, tranche pipeline status, outstanding principal and total loan balance, first-tranche disbursement, first repayment due and received amounts, BGS and Investment verification of the operational and funding-need answers, second-tranche eligibility, approved amount, planned and actual disbursement dates. Filter by office, loan officer, product, tranche pipeline status, loan status, deadline proximity, and a from/to date range over the first disbursement or approval date.

JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office branch ON branch.id = COALESCE(ml.office_id, mc.office_id) JOIN m_office scope_office ON branch.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(scope_office.hierarchy, '%') WHERE (scope_office.id = ${officeId} OR (${officeId} IN (-1, 0) AND scope_office.hierarchy = '${currentUserHierarchy}')) AND (ml.loan_officer_id = ${loanOfficerId} OR ${loanOfficerId} IN (-1, -10, 0)) AND (ml.product_id = ${loanProductId} OR ${loanProductId} IN (-1, 0)) AND (ml.loan_status_id = ${loanStatusId} OR ${loanStatusId} = -1) AND (COALESCE(ml.disbursedon_date, ml.approvedon_date, ml.submittedon_date) BETWEEN DATE('${startDate}') AND DATE('${endDate}')) ), first_disb AS ( SELECT loan_id, principal, disbursedon_date FROM ( SELECT d.loan_id, d.principal, d.disbursedon_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.disbursedon_date, d.id) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = d.loan_id WHERE d.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), second_disb AS ( SELECT loan_id, principal, disbursedon_date, COALESCE(NULLIF(receipt_number, ''), NULLIF(check_number, '')) AS payment_reference FROM ( SELECT d.loan_id, d.principal, d.disbursedon_date, d.receipt_number, d.check_number, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.disbursedon_date, d.id) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = d.loan_id WHERE d.disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE rn = 2 ), second_plan AS ( SELECT loan_id, id, principal, expected_disburse_date FROM ( SELECT d.loan_id, d.id, d.principal, d.expected_disburse_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.loan_id ORDER BY d.expected_disburse_date IS NULL, d.expected_disburse_date, d.id) AS rn FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = d.loan_id ) ranked WHERE rn = 2 ), tranche_total AS ( SELECT d.loan_id, COUNT(*) AS tranche_count FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = d.loan_id GROUP BY d.loan_id ), survey AS ( SELECT m.loan_id, m.disbursement_detail_id, CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(m.operational_status), '') = '' AND COALESCE(TRIM(m.additional_funding), '') = '' THEN 'NONE' WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(m.operational_status), '') = '' OR COALESCE(TRIM(m.additional_funding), '') = '' THEN 'INCOMPLETE' WHEN m.operational_status NOT IN ('OPERATIONAL', 'NOT_OPERATIONAL') OR m.additional_funding NOT IN ('NEEDS_FUNDS', 'DOES_NOT_NEED_FUNDS') THEN 'INCOMPLETE' WHEN m.operational_status = 'NOT_OPERATIONAL' THEN CASE WHEN m.operational_verified_by_bgs = 1 AND m.operational_verified_by_investment = 1 THEN 'NEGATIVE' ELSE 'INCOMPLETE' END WHEN m.additional_funding = 'DOES_NOT_NEED_FUNDS' THEN CASE WHEN m.funding_verified_by_bgs = 1 AND m.funding_verified_by_investment = 1 THEN 'NEGATIVE' ELSE 'INCOMPLETE' END WHEN m.operational_verified_by_bgs = 1 AND m.operational_verified_by_investment = 1 AND m.funding_verified_by_bgs = 1 AND m.funding_verified_by_investment = 1 THEN 'POSITIVE' ELSE 'INCOMPLETE' END AS survey_answer FROM m_loan_tranche_milestone m JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = m.loan_id ), chosen AS ( SELECT loan_id, disbursement_detail_id, survey_answer FROM ( SELECT srv.loan_id, srv.disbursement_detail_id, srv.survey_answer, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY srv.loan_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN sp.id IS NOT NULL AND srv.disbursement_detail_id = sp.id AND COALESCE(TRIM(m.submission_id), '') <> '' THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(TRIM(m.submission_id), '') <> '' THEN 1 WHEN sp.id IS NOT NULL AND srv.disbursement_detail_id = sp.id THEN 2 WHEN m.review_decision IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(m.review_decision) <> '' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, m.submitted_on DESC, m.id DESC ) AS rn FROM survey srv JOIN m_loan_tranche_milestone m ON m.loan_id = srv.loan_id AND m.disbursement_detail_id = srv.disbursement_detail_id LEFT JOIN second_plan sp ON sp.loan_id = srv.loan_id ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), review AS ( SELECT m.loan_id, MAX(CASE WHEN m.review_decision = 'CANCEL' THEN m.cancellation_reason END) AS cancellation_reason, MAX(CASE WHEN m.review_decision = 'CANCEL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, MAX(COALESCE(m.deadline_exception_by, m.cancelled_by)) AS approver FROM m_loan_tranche_milestone m JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = m.loan_id GROUP BY m.loan_id ), first_due AS ( SELECT rs.loan_id, rs.duedate, COALESCE(rs.principal_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.interest_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_amount, 0) + COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_amount, 0) AS due_amount, COALESCE(rs.principal_completed_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.interest_completed_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.fee_charges_completed_derived, 0) + COALESCE(rs.penalty_charges_completed_derived, 0) AS paid_amount, rs.obligations_met_on_date AS received_on FROM m_loan_repayment_schedule rs JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = rs.loan_id JOIN scoped_loan s ON s.loan_id = l.id WHERE rs.installment = COALESCE(l.grace_on_principal_periods, 0) + 1 ), pipeline AS ( SELECT ml.id AS loan_id, ml.account_no AS loan_account_number, CASE ml.loan_status_id WHEN 100 THEN 'Submitted and pending approval' WHEN 200 THEN 'Approved' WHEN 300 THEN 'Active' WHEN 303 THEN 'Transfer in progress' WHEN 304 THEN 'Transfer on hold' WHEN 400 THEN 'Withdrawn by client' WHEN 500 THEN 'Rejected' WHEN 600 THEN 'Closed' WHEN 601 THEN 'Written off' WHEN 602 THEN 'Rescheduled' WHEN 700 THEN 'Overpaid' ELSE CAST(ml.loan_status_id AS CHAR) END AS loan_status, mc.id AS client_id, COALESCE(mc.display_name, 'No client') AS client_name, branch.name AS office_name, COALESCE(ms.display_name, 'Unassigned') AS loan_officer, lp.name AS product_name, COALESCE(ml.approved_principal, 0) AS approved_principal, COALESCE(tranche_total.tranche_count, 0) AS tranche_count, CASE WHEN review.cancelled = 1 OR ml.loan_sub_status_id = 460 THEN 8 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 470 THEN 9 WHEN second_disb.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 4 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 440 THEN 5 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 450 THEN 6 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 430 AND second_plan.id IS NOT NULL THEN 3 WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 420 AND second_plan.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 WHEN first_disb.loan_id IS NOT NULL AND second_plan.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 7 END AS pipeline_status_id, COALESCE(ml.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) AS outstanding_principal, COALESCE(ml.total_outstanding_derived, 0) AS total_loan_balance, first_disb.disbursedon_date AS first_tranche_date, first_disb.principal AS first_tranche_amount, first_due.duedate AS first_repayment_due_date, first_due.due_amount AS first_repayment_amount, first_due.received_on AS first_repayment_received_date, first_due.paid_amount AS first_repayment_received_amount, CASE WHEN COALESCE(lp.require_milestone_survey, 0) = 0 THEN 'Not required' WHEN mile.loan_id IS NULL THEN 'Not captured' ELSE CONCAT( CASE mile.operational_status WHEN 'OPERATIONAL' THEN 'Operational' WHEN 'NOT_OPERATIONAL' THEN 'Not operational' ELSE 'Operational: not captured' END, ' (', CASE WHEN mile.operational_verified_by_bgs = 1 THEN 'BGS verified' ELSE 'BGS pending' END, ')', ' | Funding: ', CASE mile.additional_funding WHEN 'NEEDS_FUNDS' THEN 'Needs funds' WHEN 'DOES_NOT_NEED_FUNDS' THEN 'Does not need funds' ELSE 'not captured' END, ' (', CASE WHEN mile.funding_verified_by_bgs = 1 THEN 'BGS verified' ELSE 'BGS pending' END, ')' ) END AS bgs_verification_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(lp.require_milestone_survey, 0) = 0 THEN 'Not required' WHEN mile.loan_id IS NULL THEN 'Not captured' ELSE CONCAT( CASE mile.operational_status WHEN 'OPERATIONAL' THEN 'Operational' WHEN 'NOT_OPERATIONAL' THEN 'Not operational' ELSE 'Operational: not captured' END, ' (', CASE WHEN mile.operational_verified_by_investment = 1 THEN 'Investment verified' ELSE 'Investment pending' END, ')', ' | Funding: ', CASE mile.additional_funding WHEN 'NEEDS_FUNDS' THEN 'Needs funds' WHEN 'DOES_NOT_NEED_FUNDS' THEN 'Does not need funds' ELSE 'not captured' END, ' (', CASE WHEN mile.funding_verified_by_investment = 1 THEN 'Investment verified' ELSE 'Investment pending' END, ')' ) END AS investment_verification_status, CASE WHEN second_disb.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Already disbursed' WHEN second_plan.id IS NULL THEN 'No second tranche planned' WHEN COALESCE(lp.require_milestone_survey, 0) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN first_due.duedate IS NOT NULL AND first_due.paid_amount >= first_due.due_amount THEN 'Eligible' ELSE 'Awaiting first repayment' END WHEN first_due.duedate IS NOT NULL AND first_due.paid_amount >= first_due.due_amount THEN CASE chosen.survey_answer WHEN 'POSITIVE' THEN 'Eligible' WHEN 'NEGATIVE' THEN 'Not eligible' WHEN 'INCOMPLETE' THEN 'Survey incomplete' ELSE 'Awaiting BGS survey' END WHEN chosen.survey_answer = 'POSITIVE' THEN 'Eligible pending first repayment' WHEN chosen.survey_answer = 'NEGATIVE' THEN 'Not eligible' WHEN chosen.survey_answer = 'INCOMPLETE' THEN 'Survey incomplete' ELSE 'Awaiting BGS survey' END AS second_tranche_eligibility_status, CASE WHEN second_disb.loan_id IS NOT NULL THEN second_disb.principal WHEN ml.loan_sub_status_id = 430 THEN second_plan.principal ELSE NULL END AS second_tranche_approved_amount, second_disb.disbursedon_date AS second_tranche_actual_date, COALESCE(mile.eligibility_deadline_override, first_due.duedate) AS eligibility_deadline, CASE WHEN mile.review_decision IN ('EXTEND', 'CANCEL', 'RESCHEDULE') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS manual_review, CASE mile.review_decision WHEN 'EXTEND' THEN 'Extend' WHEN 'CANCEL' THEN 'Cancel' WHEN 'RESCHEDULE' THEN 'Reschedule' ELSE NULL END AS manual_action, CASE WHEN mile.review_decision IN ('EXTEND', 'CANCEL', 'RESCHEDULE') THEN COALESCE(mile.deadline_exception_by, mile.cancelled_by) ELSE NULL END AS manual_review_approver FROM scoped_loan s JOIN m_loan ml ON ml.id = s.loan_id JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = ml.product_id LEFT JOIN m_client mc ON mc.id = ml.client_id JOIN m_office branch ON branch.id = COALESCE(ml.office_id, mc.office_id) LEFT JOIN m_staff ms ON ms.id = ml.loan_officer_id LEFT JOIN review ON review.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN tranche_total ON tranche_total.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN first_disb ON first_disb.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN second_disb ON second_disb.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN second_plan ON second_plan.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN first_due ON first_due.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN chosen ON chosen.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN m_loan_tranche_milestone mile ON mile.loan_id = ml.id AND mile.disbursement_detail_id = chosen.disbursement_detail_id ) SELECT pipeline.loan_id AS `Loan ID`, pipeline.loan_account_number AS `Loan Account Number`, pipeline.loan_status AS `Loan Status`, pipeline.client_id AS `Client ID`, pipeline.client_name AS `Client Name`, pipeline.office_name AS `Office`, pipeline.loan_officer AS `Loan Officer`, pipeline.product_name AS `Product Name`, pipeline.approved_principal AS `Approved Principal Amount`, pipeline.outstanding_principal AS `Outstanding Principal`, pipeline.total_loan_balance AS `Total Loan Balance`, pipeline.tranche_count AS `Total number of Tranches`, CASE pipeline.pipeline_status_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Awaiting second-tranche verification' WHEN 2 THEN 'Eligible awaiting approval' WHEN 3 THEN 'Approved awaiting disbursement' WHEN 4 THEN 'Disbursed' WHEN 5 THEN 'Expired' WHEN 6 THEN 'Manual review' WHEN 8 THEN 'Cancelled' WHEN 9 THEN 'Rescheduled' ELSE 'Approved' END AS `Tranche Status`, pipeline.first_tranche_date AS `First-Tranche Date`, pipeline.first_tranche_amount AS `First-Tranche Disbursed Amount`, pipeline.first_repayment_due_date AS `First Repayment Due Date`, pipeline.first_repayment_amount AS `First Repayment Amount`, pipeline.first_repayment_received_date AS `First Repayment Received Date`, pipeline.first_repayment_received_amount AS `First Repayment Received Amount`, pipeline.bgs_verification_status AS `BGS Verification Status (Operational & Funding Need)`, pipeline.investment_verification_status AS `Investment Verification Status (Operational & Funding Need)`, pipeline.second_tranche_eligibility_status AS `Second-Tranche Eligibility Status`, pipeline.second_tranche_approved_amount AS `Second-Tranche Approved Amount`, pipeline.eligibility_deadline AS `Second-Tranche Deadline Date`, pipeline.manual_review AS `Manual Review?`, pipeline.manual_action AS `Manual Action`, pipeline.manual_review_approver AS `Manual review Approver`, pipeline.second_tranche_actual_date AS `Actual Second-Tranche Disbursement Date` FROM pipeline WHERE (${pipelineStatusId} = -1 OR pipeline.pipeline_status_id = ${pipelineStatusId}) AND ( ${deadlineProximity} = -1 OR (${deadlineProximity} = 7 AND pipeline.eligibility_deadline BETWEEN ${currentDate} AND DATE_ADD(${currentDate}, INTERVAL 7 DAY)) OR (${deadlineProximity} = 14 AND pipeline.eligibility_deadline BETWEEN ${currentDate} AND DATE_ADD(${currentDate}, INTERVAL 14 DAY)) OR (${deadlineProximity} = 1 AND pipeline.eligibility_deadline < ${currentDate}) ) ORDER BY pipeline.loan_account_number
